name: assemblyai
description: AssemblyAI: upload audio, transcribe with speakers, PII redaction and audio intelligence, subtitles and word search, and LLM Gateway prompts

nodes.title: Upload file
nodes.description: Upload a local audio/video file (inside ASSEMBLYAI_UPLOAD_DIR) or an https URL to AssemblyAI; returns an upload_url for transcribe

file.description: Audio or video file, up to 200 MB (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Transcribe audio
nodes.description: Start a transcription and wait for it (wait: false returns the id at once; billed per hour of audio plus enabled features)

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio/video, or the upload_url from upload_file

speech_models.description: Models in priority order, e.g. ["assemblyai-stt-3-7", "universal-2"] (default assemblyai-stt-3-7)

language_code.description: Language code, e.g. en, id; detected automatically when omitted

language_detection.description: Detect the language (do not combine with language_code)

keyterms_prompt.description: Domain words or phrases to boost (up to 1000 on stt-3-7, 200 on universal-2)

prompt.description: Free-text context to guide the transcription (assemblyai-stt-3-7 only)

redact_pii.description: Redact PII in the text (needs redact_pii_policies)

redact_pii_policies.description: PII types to redact, e.g. person_name, phone_number, email_address, credit_card_number

redact_pii_sub.description: How redacted PII is replaced (default hash)

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
